items.instruction: Confirm the instantiated checklist binds the source-review manifest and every included clip by artifact ID, byte count, and SHA-256; no placeholder or unbound clip remains.

Confirm all eight spans share the required canonical seed/save lineage and exact source, CK3 executable, and mod-mount identity, while each span retains its own continuous pre-action-post session identity and cleanup receipt.
Watch every clip intended for the character-led cut continuously from first frame to final frame at exactly 1.0x, without skipping, scrubbing, fast playback, or substituting sampled frames.
Confirm the lead and every policy-covered visible character are historical or provenance-bound characters, and record which spans genuinely support the same lead identity.
Confirm no prohibited world-generated official name is visible in any included clip.
Confirm fixture-only and test-only decisions, buttons, events, labels, markers, overlays, launcher, loading screens, and obstructing system notifications are absent.
Confirm compliance comes from clean source footage and not from cropping, masking, blurring, redaction, or hiding disallowed content.

In phase2_fact_quota_calibration, confirm fact and quota records are separately readable, the calibration event is identity-ready, and the provider-observed scoreboard or query revision advances after the action.

In phase2_receipt_appeal_pip, confirm the real receipt and PIP surfaces are visible, owner-subject-cycle-case identity stays stable, and the selected response state is provider-observed after the action.

In phase2_manager_governance, confirm the real identity-ready manager event is visible and the AI-owned case reaches a provider-observed terminal business state rather than only an ACK or elapsed time.
In phase2_promotion_compensation, confirm the real promotion choice and compensation result events are visible and remain bound to the same frozen case.

In phase2_hc_workforce, confirm A, B, and C use the same owner-subject case from a hash-identical checkpoint, the no-opening outcome is visible, and the branches are not represented as one chronological history.
In phase2_projects_metrics, confirm the project-choice event and contribution or metrics result are identity-ready, visible, and provider-observed after the action.
In phase2_incidents_operations, confirm X, Y, and Z surfaces appear in order and every transition plus closure is provider-observed after its action, never inferred from an ACK.
In phase2_cross_cycle_endgame, confirm the terminal institutional event is identity-ready and remains bound to the carried-debt or default-change cycle shown.

Confirm narration keeps only lead-character experiences supported by visible identity and same-case evidence; unsupported spans are framed as simultaneous institutional context without causal wording.
For every planned narration claim, record keep, narrow, or delete according to the observed footage; do not search for decorative footage to preserve unsupported wording.
